events.label: Alfred Wallis discovered by modernist painters

slots.name: discovery date
slots.sentence: He was discovered in 1928, when he was spotted by the modernist painters Ben Nicholson and Christopher Wood while painting at his kitchen table.

slots.name: painting start age
slots.sentence: Wallis, who had no training and little money, began painting in his 70s, after the death of his wife, using discarded marine paints to create works on found objects, like the backs of train schedules or grocery boxes.
